wiki.title: Kimberly Pope Adams
wiki.extract: Kimberly Pope Adams is an American politician who is the elected member of the Virginia House of Delegates for the 82nd District. She took office as a member of the 164th Virginia General Assembly on January 14, 2026. She won election on November 4, 2025, defeating Republican incumbent Kim Taylor by a margin of about 9%, a massive swing after losing to Taylor by 53 votes in 2023.
